svg.title: Tandem-rotor helicopter — Þyrla með tvo langsum þyrilvængi
svg.desc: A long transport helicopter has a separate main rotor on a mast at each end of its cabin.
svg.metadata: {"collection":"UteamUP Sectors and Nature","subject":"aviation-tandem-helicopter","label_en":"Tandem-rotor helicopter","label_is":"Þyrla með tvo langsum þyrilvængi","section":"04","category_en":"Aircraft and flight","category_is":"Loftför og flug","batch":2,"tags":["aviation","rotorcraft"],"description":"A long transport helicopter has a separate main rotor on a mast at each end of its cabin.","design_note":"Widely spaced fore and aft lifting rotors distinguish tandem from coaxial and single-rotor layouts.","style":{"viewBox":[0,0,24,24],"stroke":"#1655A6","stroke_width":0.9,"fill":"none","background":"transparent"}}
